title: Kicked Crispy Mexican Tofu Bowl
description: A bold, bitter, crispy bowl of Mexican-inspired tofu with stout-infused glaze, cooked sous-vide and finished in a donabe for crunch.
instructions: Season 400g firm tofu with 30ml soy sauce, 20ml maple syrup, 1 tsp chili powder, minced ginger, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt; vacuum seal.
Place sealed tofu in the water bath for 45 minutes to cook evenly.
In a small saucepan, combine 200ml stout, 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp lime zest, and 1 tbsp lime juice; simmer until reduced by half to a glaze.
Remove tofu from bag, pat dry, and drizzle with the reduced stout glaze, letting it absorb for 5 minutes.
Heat the donabe over medium-high, add a splash of oil, and pan-fry tofu until golden and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, cook 200g rice according to package, then warm 1 can black beans and 1 cup corn in a skillet with a dash of cumin.
Assemble bowls by layering rice, beans, corn, crispy tofu, and topping with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime.
